maria_cs: Hey team — NimbusHealth asked for a mix of office hours + a short workshop next week. They need APAC-friendly times and a separate slot for technical ticket triage. Can we propose 2x 60m blocks (one APAC evening, one US morning) + a 30m triage drop-in? :calendar: 

jordan_se: I can do the US morning. Prefer 10am PT or 11am PT. 10am PT keeps our EMEA folks awake-friendly. :+1:

lee_enablement: For APAC they asked for later in SGT — thinking 8:30pm SGT works best (that's noon PT). Would that conflict with your 10am PT? math-wise it's about 2.5 hours diff.

sam_cs_manager: Let's avoid overlapping. Proposed plan:
```
Mon 10:00am PT — Customer office hours (60m) — leads: jordan_se, anya_prod
Tue 20:30 SGT — Enablement workshop (60m) — leads: lee_enablement, maria_cs
Wed 11:30am PT — 30m triage drop-in — leads: maria_cs
```
This gives a buffer day between sessions to incorporate feedback. Thoughts?

anya_prod: I can host the workshop hands-on demo for model onboarding in the APAC slot. Will prep a 20m demo + 30m Q&A. Request: can we record and auto-upload to workspace?

maria_cs: Yes, please record. calendar-bot — can you create provisional invites and run a quick emoji poll for availability? We'll finalize in 24h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

calendar-bot: Created provisional events and posted a 24h availability poll. Poll link: https://cal.redwood.ai/poll/AB12CD (expires 24h)

jordan_se: Voted. I prefer Mon 10am PT and Wed triage. Also can help with triage doc.

lee_enablement: Voted for Tue APAC slot. Quick note: please add a short prep doc section for "S3 access + model pins" so we don't get stuck in sign-in problems.

maria_cs: Good call. @lee_enablement can you drop the prep checklist in the #cs-templates repo? small bullets only.

lee_enablement: Done — link: https://git.internal/redwood/cs-templates/enablement-checklist.md — added items for S3, KMS, model-version pins.

sam_cs_manager: If poll closes with >80% availability, we lock events. If not, we fallback to one US + one flexible evening slot. Also let's set a signup cap at 12 participants to keep it interactive.

anya_prod: Recording question — is the recording automatically transcribed? We should attach the transcript to the follow-up note.

maria_cs: Yes, recording + auto-transcript will be on if zoom creds are used. I added that to the calendar invite notes.

jordan_se: I'll draft the triage agenda: short triage protocol (10m), common errors (10m), hands-on ticket walk (10m). Will post in thread later.

maria_cs: Perfect. Last ask: add an emoji reaction to the poll with :white_check_mark: for go or :clock1: if you prefer alternate times. We'll finalize at 1758881340 (24m from now).

lee_enablement: :white_check_mark:

jordan_se: :white_check_mark:

anya_prod: :white_check_mark:

sam_cs_manager: :clock1: (I might be out for the APAC slot, but ok with recording)

calendar-bot: Poll closed. Results: 4/5 prefer proposed slots, 1/5 prefer alternate. Events locked and invites sent.

calendar-bot: Event created — Mon 10:00am PT (ID: ev-9832). Event created — Tue 20:30 SGT (ID: ev-9833). Event created — Wed 11:30am PT triage (ID: ev-9834).

maria_cs: Awesome. I'll send the customer the prep checklist + recording/transcript note and confirm the signup cap. Thanks team! :tada:
